latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of editor-change-background.
- Instantly replace and edit video backgrounds using AI—just upload a clip and describe the desired look.
- Handles 30-second talking-head video clips, supporting uploads up to 500MB, and returns a 1080p MP4 in under a minute.
- No manual editing: Simply type your instructions for background swaps or quick content cleanup.
- Integrated cloud rendering pipeline; all processing is remote—no local install required.
- Easy session and credit handling with a built-in free trial token system.
- Supports common video and audio formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac).
